statement.p: A mountain is 1100 feet above sea level. A trench is 360 feet below sea level. What is the difference in elevation between the mountain top and the bottom of the trench?

solution.p: The height of the mountain is simply 1100 feet because it is above sea level.
The bottom of the trench is -360 feet in height. Note that it is negative because it is below sea level.
To find the difference in height, we use subtraction:
The difference in elevation from the mountain top to the bottom of the trench is {1460\ {\rm ft}}.
